messages:
kevin: Heads-up — audit export for yesterday's role refactor shows ~120 role-change events but ~18 have actor:null or actor:"service_tombstone". Anyone seeing gaps?
anika: which export? raw blob or the compliance CSV? :thinking:
kevin: the S3 dump: s3://redwood-audit/2026-03-19/role-changes.ndjson. Quick peek, e.g.:
```json
{"ts":"2026-03-19T02:11:34Z","event":"role.update","role":"analytics_reader","actor":null,"changes":["perm:read->perm:read"]}
{"ts":"2026-03-19T02:12:01Z","event":"role.update","role":"analytics_reader","actor":"service_tombstone","changes":["perm:read->perm:read"]}
```
maya: ugh. actor:null usually means the reconciler service did it but didn't attach principal. We pushed a change last week that replaced the reconciler wrapper — maybe lost metadata. @oliver any deploys around 02:10 UTC?
oliver: deploy-bot: release/role-reconciler v2.4.1 deployed at 2026-03-19T02:05Z :rocket:
sec-infra-bot: automated note: role-reconciler v2.4.1 changed schema: removed legacy "actor_id" field, replaced with "principal". Migration flag was enabled.
anika: so schema change might have left old events unpopulated? Did we forget compatibility code to set actor=principal when principal missing?
kevin: exact suspicion. In the reconciler code we have:
```py
evt = {
  "ts": now.isoformat(),
  "event": "role.update",
  "role": role.name,
  "actor": ctx.actor_id,  # new field is ctx.principal
  "changes": diffs,
}
```
looks like ctx.actor_id stayed unset unless we map principal -> actor_id.
maya: quick triage plan:
1) grep S3 to get all role.update with actor null
2) identify time window around reconciler deploy
3) confirm whether the compliance pipeline ingested null actors as "unknown" vs dropped
anika: I'll take (3) — checking the compliance ingestion lambda logs now.
oliver: I can backfill producer side: add mapping in reconciler and re-emit events for the window (idempotent) if we can link commit ids.
sec-infra-bot: note: KMS-decryption used by the ingestion lambda rotated keys 2026-03-18T23:00Z — no errors in logs but double-checking.
compliance: if actor missing we fail a couple of reports; P0 for audit completeness for the quarter. Need an ETA for fix/backfill.
kevin: estimate: mapping + small reemit -> 4h dev + 1h QA + backfill helper running overnight. But we need approval to re-emit events to the audit bucket — legal/compliance signoff?
compliance: please don't alter historical audit objects in place. We need an append-only backfill with provenance meta (re_emitted_by, original_ts). We'll approve a backfill plan that leaves originals untouched.
oliver: plan: add "provenance" envelope:
```json
{
 "re_emitted_by":"role-reconciler-backfill/oliver",
 "original_ts":"2026-03-19T02:11:34Z",
 "reason":"fill missing actor"
}
```
kevin: good. Also need to check KMS signing for the backfill objects — ingestion rejects unsigned payloads.
sec-infra-bot: reminder: backfill objects must be encrypted with customer KMS alias "audit-prod" and include x-amz-meta-provenance header. I'll attach runbook steps.
anika: compliance lambda log: it marked actor:null events as "UNKNOWN_ACTOR" and forwarded them but the compliance report generator filters UNKNOWN_ACTOR rows out. So backfill needed.
maya: triage decision: treat as compliance P1, backfill approved as append-only with provenance and key-tagging. Also add reconciler hotfix to map ctx.principal->actor before next deploy.
kevin: I'll open a PR and ping for review. Also adding unit tests around event schema. Anyone want to review the backfill tool tomorrow morning?
oliver: I'll take review. Can we also add an alert that tracks ratio of null-actor role.update events >0.1%?
anika: yes, I'll add that to the observability board. Rule: if >0.05% over 1h, page eng-sre.
kevin: thanks all. filing a short incident ticket. /incident create role-audit-null-actors  P1
sec-infra-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0423 (role-audit-null-actors) linked.
compliance: once backfill runs, update me with the S3 manifest. We'll re-run the quarterly report subset.
maya: will follow up after backfill completes, reassigning to oliver for rollout and kevin for PR.
